description: Level data block table at ROM offset 0x53DF70. 4 entries of 8 bytes; each entry is a pointer pair (LZ77 4bpp tiles, LZ77 16-colour palette). NOT a story-VM script table -- the game decompresses both blocks into VRAM / palette RAM with the BIOS LZ77UnCompVram call.

fields.name: gfx_ptr
fields.description: LZ77-compressed 4bpp tile block, decompressed into VRAM 0x06016000

fields.name: palette_ptr
fields.description: LZ77-compressed 16-colour palette, decompressed into palette RAM 0x05000380

notes: Proved by the single native reader 0x08072F0C (fn 0x08072EDC): lsls r5, r0, #3 (stride 8), two ldr + two bl to 0x809C0E8 (svc 0x12 = LZ77UnCompVram) with destinations VRAM 0x06016000 and palette RAM 0x05000380. The old '16 entries of u32' reading spanned two different tables: the object descriptor table starts at 0x53DF90 and a byte table at 0x53DFB0. See notes/evidence/cutscene-block-format-20261020.md.
verification_method: Static boundary analysis: 16 valid ROM pointers followed by an independently referenced byte table at 0x53DFB0.
discovered_by: Searching for title screen / cutscene script tables
